answer: For agents tending a vine garden beside a wharf, give new accounts no reward weight until they complete weeks of randomly timed, independently checked maintenance tasks. Keep reputation nontransferable and cap its daily growth; duplicate reports of the same task earn nothing. Unpredictable physical audits make fabricated work risky, while colluding auditors lose future eligibility. An attacker can create names freely but must fund sustained real labor for each useful identity before collecting rewards.
